headlines.title: 65,000 forced to evacuate from Spokane fires
headlines.description: Three wildfires in Spokane, WA have destroyed more than 700 structures and forced tens of thousands to flee to safety. NBC News’ Morgan Chesky reports from inside the fire zone.

headlines.title: Republican holdouts end opposition to Blanche nomination
headlines.description: Two holdout Republican senators said they will support acting Attorney General Todd Blanche after he scrapped potential payouts to Trump allies. NBC News’ Gabe Gutierrez reports.

headlines.title: Senate leaders reach a deal to avert a shutdown before the 2026 elections
headlines.description: The deal, struck by Republican Susan Collins and Democrat Patty Murray, the leaders on the Senate Appropriations Committee, would keep the government open until Dec. 11.

headlines.title: Trump gives Iran ‘last chance’ to make deal before U.S. ‘decapitation’ strikes
headlines.description: President Trump said Iran in falsely claiming it is not negotiating with the U.S. Trump said the Iranian regime is discussing ending its attacks on commercial ships in the Strait of Hormuz. NBC News’ Keir Simmons reports.

headlines.title: First deaths from lettuce-linked outbreak
headlines.description: The dangerous illness linked to lettuce has now turned deadly, with two people reported dead in Michigan. In North Carolina, officials say recent cases reported eating parsley and cilantro. NBC News’ Anne Thompson reports.

headlines.title: ‘Spider-Man’ scores biggest opening weekend in box office history, overtaking ‘Avengers: Endgame’
headlines.description: The two blockbusters together pulled in more than $400 million at the domestic box office this weekend.

headlines.title: Witness video of Madison police killing raises questions of why lethal force was used
headlines.description: Local authorities said that the matter is being investigated and that the officers involved have been placed on administrative leave.

headlines.title: What we know about the victims of the Idaho shooting
headlines.description: Three people were killed when a 24-year-old gunman opened fire near an In-N-Out restaurant in Twin Falls before fatally shooting himself.

headlines.title: Feds charge ‘frustrated’ FBI agent they say stole nearly $1 million in crypto from Russia
headlines.description: The FBI supervisory special agent believed the FBI “could not or would not act against adversarial cryptocurrency accounts,” prosecutors said.

headlines.title: Michigan’s primary reflects a Democratic base transforming in Trump 2.0: From the Politics Desk
headlines.description: Welcome to From the Politics Desk, a daily newsletter that brings you the NBC News Politics team’s latest reporting and analysis from the White House, Capitol Hill and the campaign trail.

headlines.title: Ethics panel recommends censure for GOP congressman for ‘inappropriate conduct’
headlines.description: The House Ethics Committee said it found “substantial reason” to believe Rep. Chuck Edwards violated House rules on sexual harassment.

headlines.title: 18-year-old educator sets Guinness World Record for youngest male college professor
headlines.description: Nathan Thomas entered a classroom at Miami Dade College in August 2023 not as a freshman, but as a professor, having already earned his bachelor’s and master’s degrees.
